title: GLPI Security Update Protects the System That Maps the Fleet
caption:
CERT-FR documented eight GLPI security advisories affecting versions 11.0.x before 11.0.8 and older branches before 10.0.26. Risks include privilege escalation, SQL injection, and authorization problems. Defenders must update the platform, verify privileged roles, and check dependencies.
